zeroAbduction.method: Terminal 10% real skinned vertices with >=0.5 digit weight, projected on the lateral palm axis; distal 35% also reported for comparison. Long fingers index/middle/ring/pinky; thumb tested independently as an opposable digit. Bone chords must be parallel within 0.01 degrees. This is the lateral tip-silhouette opening, not Euclidean tip-centre distance or a per-slice maximum on rounded caps. No assumed skin radii; no change to the 412 centreline gate.

limits: Fixed-step CPU. The 412 gate measures centreline segments, not skin surfaces. Zero-abduction measures the lateral opening in real distal skin silhouettes, separately from the bone gate. Contact exceptions are only named pairs in anim-r3-seals.json. Zone/finger state/elbow gates are endpoint constraints; transitions change zone and curl continuously. Browser and visual acceptance remain with Claude.
